faqItems.question: Can I use Hypa API for commercial projects?
faqItems.answer: Yes. All paid plans include commercial usage rights with credit-based pricing — you only pay for what you use. Contact us for enterprise plans with custom SLAs.

faqItems.question: Is there a free tier?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The free tier includes limited API calls per month, access to all model types, and basic analytics — ideal for prototyping. Upgrade for higher rate limits and priority access.

faqItems.question: Can I switch between providers?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Change the "provider" and "model" parameters in your request. The request/response format is consistent across providers, making switching seamless.

faqItems.question: How do I contact support?
faqItems.answer: Email support@hypaintelligence.com with your request ID and a description of the issue. Include "URGENT" in the subject for production-blocking problems. We respond within 24 hours.
